column3: Menardi has the Stars and\nyour friends. She waits on\nthe road below Imil.{end_wait}
Where? Where is Jenna!?{end_wait}
Out of your reach, until\nit is finished. I am sorry\nfor that.{end_wait}
Sorry changes nothing.\nYou took her from us.{end_wait}
Then follow. I will not\nstop you again.{end_wait}
Wait. Where is Mia? She\nwent after Menardi alone!{end_wait}
Then we hurry. She cannot\nface Menardi alone!{end_wait}
...{end_wait}
She's gone ahead. Come\non, we have to catch up!{end_wait}
Menardi. I have followed\nyou a long way. Stop.{end_wait}
The healer, and alone.\nYour friends could not\nkeep pace?{end_wait}
Whoever you are, please!\nHelp us!{end_wait}
I will. Stay close to me.{end_wait}
The beacon you lit is mine\nto guard. Give them back,\nor I take them.{end_wait}
I do not want this fight,\nhealer. But I cannot give\nthem back.{end_wait}
Then you leave me no\nchoice.{end_wait}
Enough... You are stronger\nthan I thought. I will not\nthrow my life away here.{end_wait}
The Stars and the captives\ncome with me. Follow, if\nyou are willing.{end_wait}
Mia! Are you hurt?{end_wait}
Menardi took them all:\nJenna, Kraden, Felix, and\nthe Stars.{end_wait}
Then we follow. Together\nthis time.{end_wait}
...Together. Fine. Keep up.{end_wait}
